{{Infobox league |name=QuakeWorld SuperLeague 2 |image=qwsl-logo_01.png |series= |organizer={{player|Link|flag=no}} |sponsor= |type=Online |format=4on4 |prizepool= |sdate=2025-02-16 |edate= |year=2025 |website= |discord=discord.gg/yWphgHT2XS |twitch= |teamfirst= |teamfirstflag= |teamsecond= |teamsecondflag= |teamthird= |teamthirdflag= |teamfourth= |teamfourthflag= |team_number= |map1=steam |map2=qobblestone |map3=stronghold |map4=rocka |map5=obsidian |map6=italy |map7=dust2qw |map8=anwalked |map9=stroggopolis }} The '''QuakeWorld Superleague''' is a 4on4 league making 1-2 seasons per calender year. It is a standard 1 game per week with divisions based on team skill. This is season number 2. Season 1 here: [[QWSL]]. Since [[EQL]] already decided on TB5 those maps will not be in the QWSL, focus will be on other maps.

This season we will try something new; we add 3 new maps and map pool is reduced to 9 maps. Also the new map [[Steam]] will be played in every game with the format:

{{Abbr/GO3}}: '''play-steam pick pick'''
{{Abbr/BO5}} playoffs: '''toss toss play-steam pick pick pick toss toss play'''

The highest division(s) will be for signed up teams, the lowest division will be draft. Signed up teams may be allowed to enter the lowest (draft) division if the skill is about the same level (admin decision).

Head admin of the league is [[Image:flag_no.gif]] [[Link]]. League start is February 16, 2025. Signup ends February 10. 2025.
